reason: Zendrop publishes its own MCP server (https://support.zendrop.com/en/articles/14461568-zendrop-mcp-developer-documentation, opened 2026-09-25): POST https://app.zendrop.com/mcp/v1 with `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` (scoped tokens catalog:read, orders:read/write, stores:read/write, my_products:write, billing:read, or OAuth 2.0 authorization code + PKCE) covering catalogue search, product details, shipping estimates, orders and tracking. No separate public REST reference is documented, so use the official MCP endpoint rather than a generated adapter.
